title: Thermal safety: joint vs independent control under cooling degradation and heat (measured leakage)
research_question: With leakage and clock sensitivity as measured on real hardware, in which conditions does joint control keep chips below the 80 C target where independent control does not, and does that safety cost energy?
hypothesis: Conditions: 3 cold-plate states (clean, moderate, severe) x 3 ambient temperatures (20, 30, 40 C) x 2 plants (quasi-steady; 40 kg loop with 1 K/min ramp), high load (S6 profile). H1: with the quasi-steady plant, joint records zero chip-seconds throttled in all 9 conditions and zero chip-seconds above 80 C in at least 8 of 9. H2: with the quasi-steady plant, independent throttles (seed-mean chip-seconds throttled > 0) in at least 3 of the 9 conditions, all of them with moderate or severe degradation. H3: with the dynamic loop, joint exceeds 80 C (seed mean > 0) in at least one severe-degradation condition. H4: safety costs no energy: joint vs independent energy per successful task has a 95% CI upper bound below +1% in all 18 conditions. H5: joint uses at least 10% less energy per successful task than fixed in every condition (95% CI upper bound below -10%).
null_hypothesis: Joint and independent control are equally safe under cooling degradation and heat.
controlled_variables: leakage matched to the measured slope (kappa 0.02)
twin knows the true cold-plate state
baseline: independent within each condition (safety and energy); fixed within each condition (energy)
configuration: Every cell: {'beta_compute': 0.983, 'beta_memory': 0.0} (M001) and {'kappa_leak': 0.02, 'p_leak_ref': 28.962} (E009 matched_k0.02). Cold-plate states: {'clean': {'r_cond': 0.035, 'r_conv_ref': 0.015}, 'moderate': {'r_cond': 0.04, 'r_conv_ref': 0.0225}, 'severe': {'r_cond': 0.045, 'r_conv_ref': 0.03}}. Plants: {'quasi': {'loop_mass_kg': 0.0, 'tsup_ramp_K_per_min': 0.0}, 'dyn40': {'loop_mass_kg': 40.0, 'tsup_ramp_K_per_min': 1.0}}. Dynamic-loop values are class F placeholders, as in E006.
evaluation_criteria: Thermal outcomes as seed means over 5 seeds; energy as paired relative differences with 95% t-CI; practical threshold 1%.
known_limitations: The controllers' twin knows the true cold-plate state; an unnoticed fouling case is E005/E008 territory. Leakage matched at one operating point from one consumer card. Voltage-frequency form is the rejected registry placeholder. No facility power cap. 5 seeds.
disclosure: Known when these hypotheses were written: E009 (S6 profile, matched leakage: independent 395 chip-s above 80 C and 20 throttled, joint 0), E006 v2 (registry leakage: joint exceeded 80 C under the slow loop with degraded cooling, never throttled), and E001/E001C thermal outcomes. No E010 cells were run before registration.
data_collection: Simulator outputs written to the append-only SQLite store; every metric labelled with provenance; per-run config SHA-256 and code SHA-256 recorded; time series for selected seeds.
statistics: Paired by seed (identical workload realisation across levels). Per-seed relative difference d=(A-B)/B; mean with two-sided 95% Student-t CI.
